#  Introduction 

通过研究影响Patients rates的因素，可以帮助苏格兰政府有针对性地对精神病潜在患者进行干预（如：潜在患者的性别，年龄，贫困程度等），减少精神病发病率。

# Exploratory Data Analysis
1.Visualization:
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
age_sex <- read_csv("age.sex.csv")
deprivation <- read_csv("deprivation.csv")
plot_deprivation <- deprivation %>%
  filter(
    Dataset == "SMR04",
    HBR == "S92000003",
    SIMD %in% 1:5,
    is.finite(PatientsRates)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SIMD = factor(SIMD, levels = 1:5)
  )
ggplot(plot_deprivation,
       aes(x = SIMD,
           y = PatientsRates,
           fill = SIMD)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "1" = "#E63946",
      "2" = "#457B9D",
      "3" = "#2A9D8F",
      "4" = "#9B59B6",
      "5" = "#F4A261"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mental Health Inpatient Rates by SIMD",
    subtitle = "Scotland",
    x = "SIMD Quintile",
    y = "Patients per 100,000 Population"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

\text{patientrates}_t=\alpha+\beta_1 \cdot \text{SIMD}_t+\beta_2\cdot\text{dischargerates}_t+\beta_3\cdot\text{age}_t+\beta_4\cdot\text{sex}_t
$$

3.correlation表格+error term：
```{r}
# 1. 加载包
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(gt)
merged_data <- inner_join(
  age.sex, 
  deprivation, 
  by = c("HBR", "FinancialYear") 
) %>%
  rename(
    PatientsRates = PatientsRates.x,
    DischargeRates = DischargeRates.x,
    AgeGroup = AgeGroup,
    Sex = Sex
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y"))
print(colnames(merged_data))
model_full <- lm(PatientsRates ~ SIMD + DischargeRates + AgeGroup + Sex, 
                 data = merged_data, 
                 na.action = na.omit)
print(names(coef(model_full)))
model_table <- tidy(model_full) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value_clean = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p.value, 4))),
    Significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    ),
    Estimate_Star = paste0(round(estimate, 4), Significance),
    Variables = case_when(
      term == "(Intercept)"    ~ "Alpha (Intercept)",
      term == "SIMD"           ~ "Beta 1: SIMD",
      term == "DischargeRates" ~ "Beta 2: Discharge Rates",
      grepl("AgeGroup", term)  ~ paste0("Beta 3: ", term),
      grepl("Sex", term)       ~ paste0("Beta 4: ", term),
      TRUE                     ~ term
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Variables, 
    `Coefficients (β)` = Estimate_Star, 
    `Std. Error` = std.error, 
    `t-value` = statistic, 
    `p-value` = p_value_clean
  )
error_info <- summary(model_full)$sigma
gt_table <- gt(model_table) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Regression Results**"),
    subtitle = "Dependent Variable: Patient Rates"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`Std. Error`, `t-value`), decimals = 4) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md(paste0("**Note:** * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001. Residual Std. Error (Error Term) = ", round(error_info, 4), " on ", df.residual(model_full), " degrees of freedom."))
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = "16px", table.width = pct(100))
gt_table
```
